runs.text: Do Jews kill more? Let's check fourteen countries. They say Israel is a murderous society. Let's measure it: murders per one hundred thousand people. Jewish Israelis, zero point eight five. Lower than Germany, the UK and France. World average five point two, the US five point eight. Brazil nineteen, Mexico twenty five. Now Israel's neighbours. The UAE zero point seven, Saudi Arabia zero point nine, Jordan one. Egypt one point three, Lebanon two point two, Turkey three point two, Syria no reliable data. Some of the safest on this list. Now the honest part. Israel as a whole, three, above every neighbour but Turkey. Double its two thousand and nineteen rate. Most victims are Arab citizens, eleven per one hundred thousand, thirteen times the Jewish rate. Mostly organised crime, and under one in ten of those murders get solved. The state is failing them. And yes, we kill too, sometimes by accident, sometimes deliberately. Every number is a life. What should Israel do first? So, do Jews kill more?
